summary.text: Ray Pooley is the Democratic nominee, a CNC machinist and programmer making his first run for Congress. He describes himself as a third-generation manufacturer. His campaign website lists manufacturing jobs, family farms and tax fairness among its priorities.

paragraphs.text: Ray Pooley graduated from Hartland High School and works as a CNC machinist and programmer.
In his Ballotpedia survey he describes himself as a third-generation manufacturer with 15 years of personal experience in the industry.
Pooley advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary for Michigan's 9th District; this is his first run for Congress.

sources.title: Pooley's Candidate Connection survey responses, quoted by Ballotpedia
